scope: This discharges the polynomial square-product-to-scaling and forward classification step. It does not prove that a square in the rational function field is represented by a constant times a polynomial square, construct the multiquadratic Kummer characters, or prove their pairwise separation.
statement: For a nonsingular short cubic over a field of characteristic not two, a nonzero constant-times-square factorization of the cubic times its nontrivially scaled copy forces exactly the exceptional scaling classes in Lemma 5.4: if A is nonzero then B is zero and r is minus one; if A is zero and B is nonzero then r cubed is one.
